approaches.title: Hash set sequence scanning
approaches.summary: Stores the numbers in a hash set and examines consecutive runs by scanning neighboring values. The second revision expresses the same strategy with iterators and correctly begins scans at sequence starts.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Builds a hash set and scans consecutive values from selected elements to track the longest run.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 128: one big iterator for fun
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Refactors the hash-set scan into iterator chains and selects values without predecessors as sequence starts.
